preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 5 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the range of 1 to n.
The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= uj <= n and 1 <= vj <= n and 1 <= xj <= n and 1 <= yj <= n and uj != vj and xj != yj for uj, vj, xj, yj in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case must specify valid and distinct cities within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' if uj == xj and vj == yj else stdout != '0'
postconditions.description: If JH and JY start at the same cities, they meet immediately, otherwise, the output is not zero.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(meeting_time > 0 for meeting_time in meeting_times) else stdout != '-1'
postconditions.description: If no valid meeting time is found, output -1, otherwise, output a valid meeting time.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(meeting_time, int) and meeting_time >= 0 for meeting_time in meeting_times)
postconditions.description: All meeting times must be non-negative integers.
